objective: Produce a reusable portable UI/UX engineering skill package with actual bounded evaluation evidence.
source: User authoring contract and subsequent instructions to add a new SaaS roles folder and reviewed skills.sh shortlist.

runtime.core: Portable Agent Skills Markdown; host capability discovery required
runtime.scripts: Node >=24; optional existing TypeScript compiler, Playwright module and Chromium browser
runtime.hostMetadata: No host-specific metadata required or tool grants declared

exclusions: Uninspected inaccessible references or verified integrations without evidence
Global installation, public upload, publication or production change without authorization
acceptance: Eight conditional modules with complete contracts
Source skills and qualifying UI repositories independently inspected
Entry <500 lines; progressive detail and resolving resources
Every packaged script exercised, including meaningful failure paths
Eight realistic fresh-context cases, two held out from tuning, twelve activation prompts
C01/C06 compare frozen skill versus disabled baseline three times each
Preserved raw evidence, actual counts and truthful unverified coverage

authoringLimits.scope: Revisions based on demonstrated public defects; heldout not used to tune

status: Contract established; results are in the final report, not inferred here
